title: Custom Goal Seconds required
body:
Hi ,
Thank you so much for the wonderful app , this would really help in meeting the goals. There are 2 feature requests for specific use cases. I am hoping that this could be a quick win for you and for me and would be there in the next release.

1) Ability to set time based goals in seconds , the option should not be limited minutes.

2) Ability to show success in count in complication and widgets for time based goals.

Use case : How many times i completed a 10 second goal

Awaiting Response

Many Thanks.

with regards

title: Improvements
body:
